method: read each printed sentence against its query; relevant = the sentence answers the question or states its point; marginal = same document/topic but does not answer it; irrelevant = different topic or boilerplate. Document test applied mechanically before the judgement: for every sample the query's source file and the printed record's source file were resolved from the frozen pool; 0 of 20 share a file.
notes: all 20 fallbacks were ranked by address order (zero shared blocks); every one printed the first sentence of the same record 0, so the sample is a single output string repeated 20 times
the 20 queries span written-unadmitted, unknown, unrelated and union rows; none asks about the LifeStatusView split the sentence reports
the one fallback with a shared block (fallback_basis = record_overlap) was not sampled because the stride skipped it; it is reported in the aggregate distribution
